title: EDG Community Update: Week of October 11th
body:
**Highlights**
- Decent Partners shared [a small update on Kabocha](https://twitter.com/monsieurbulb/status/1436440404652609544?s=20).
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3 or later](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-oct-10/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [Zien’s Trilobita Drop and Paradoxides Auction](https://twitter.com/joinzien/status/1448243134421422081?s=20) are now live.
- Commonwealth partnered with [SZNS](https://twitter.com/hicommonwealth/status/1448738059705585666?s=20).
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- Proposal in the pipeline: Edgeware Community FIlm by Lemonade Money


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal).
